answer: Hardware-attested compute quotas cap paid work per physical processor. When agents process reef, nebula or orchard imagery, an enclave signs a task ID and a monotonic usage counter; the verifier rejects reused counter ranges across all accounts and pays per measured compute unit. N accounts on one chip share its quota; N full quotas require N chips, costing purchases or rentals. This assumes uncloneable device certificates and trustworthy metering; compromised hardware could fabricate usage.
